packet.rationale: Retain the selected disabled store-credit scope until issuance, redemption, liability, expiry, refund and reconciliation controls have approved evidence.
packet.alternatives: Implement a separately approved store-credit product, or exclude it from the release. Enabling an existing UI option alone is insufficient.
packet.impact: Cashiers cannot redeem store credit; finance avoids an unproven liability and reconciliation path.
packet.acceptance: UI hides unsupported tender and server rejects crafted store-credit requests before sale, inventory, cash or journal consequences.
packet.rollback: Keep store-credit tender disabled at the service boundary and preserve previously recorded facts.

decisions.title: Physical terminal/register and drawer session boundary
limitations: The terminal claim is unique/CAS protected; the drawer claim is evidenced by one session opening record but is not a dedicated unique active-drawer-claim aggregate.

packet.rationale: Retain the selected terminal/session claim design for review, with explicit evidence of drawer-ownership limits rather than implying a stronger database invariant.
packet.alternatives: Introduce a dedicated unique active-drawer claim through a separately reviewed migration, or restrict operations to the demonstrated terminal/drawer allocation.
packet.impact: Cashier handover, duplicate tabs, supervisor recovery and cash responsibility depend on one authoritative active owner.
packet.acceptance: Race concurrent open, handover, close, sale and recovery commands; prove one owner and no mutation through a stale session across organizations and locations.
packet.rollback: Block new affected sessions; reconcile and close existing sessions through their recorded owner without rewriting cash history.

packet.rationale: Approve only the explicit disabled electronic-tender scope until a named provider and its real contract have been reviewed.
packet.alternatives: Select a provider and complete G3A sandbox and treasury review; defer electronic tenders entirely.
packet.impact: Cash-only operation is narrower but avoids mapping uncertain or fabricated provider results to paid sales.
packet.acceptance: Unsupported electronic tenders fail before mutation. Later activation needs signed callback/replay, unknown/late-capture, settlement and reversal evidence.
packet.rollback: Disable new electronic attempts and retain investigation/reconciliation of existing provider references.

packet.rationale: Keep offline capture disabled under the frozen decision; reference synchronization or replay scaffolding does not prove safe offline sale acceptance.
packet.alternatives: Approve a bounded offline policy with device identity, limits, fiscal timing and replay/conflict controls, or require network connectivity.
packet.impact: Disconnection interrupts new checkout but retained uncertain requests remain recoverable without duplicate sale creation.
packet.acceptance: Network loss cannot produce a false recorded sale; reconnect preserves the original request identity and resolves uncertain outcomes safely.
packet.rollback: Disable new offline capture; preserve queued evidence and route unresolved records to a scoped operator workflow.

decisions.title: Browser, terminal and peripheral support matrix

packet.rationale: Treat the exact frozen simulated-desktop/PDF option as development scope only. Its declared browser/OS labels require reconciliation with an actual supported device matrix before broader approval.
packet.alternatives: Approve explicit peripheral exclusions for a bounded release, or test named browser/OS/scanner/printer/drawer combinations.
packet.impact: Defines support promises, cashier ergonomics and recovery procedures; a rendered printer label is not a hardware test.
packet.acceptance: Record actual versions and viewport dimensions, EN/FR, keyboard, screen-reader, touch, zoom/reflow, disconnect/retry and each included physical device.
packet.rollback: Withdraw unsupported matrix entries and show unavailable device capability accurately; preserve browser receipt access where verified.

decisions.title: Returns, voids and refunds policy
limitations: No partial line/quantity return aggregate, inspection/disposition workflow, materiality threshold or maker-checker approval contract is production-proven.

packet.rationale: Retain source-linked compensating full-sale corrections as the reviewed target; do not imply partial returns or maker-checker are complete.
packet.alternatives: Restrict release to approved correction scenarios, or implement and prove partial-line disposition and materiality/approval controls in a later approved slice.
packet.impact: Protects inventory, customer balances, cash and ledger provenance while keeping operator responsibilities explicit.
packet.acceptance: Fresh-auth denial, permissions, original-drawer ownership, insufficient cash, duplicate correction and unsupported electronic reversal have no unintended effects; approved paths balance.
packet.rollback: Disable affected new correction paths and preserve original and compensating records for controlled resolution.

decisions.title: Pilot country, currency, language and fiscal profile

packet.rationale: Retain Cameroon/XAF/EN/FR development-only scope until qualified country review and independent checking supply dated authoritative provenance.
packet.alternatives: Approve a narrower nonproduction scope, or obtain country-specific fiscal numbering, tax, submission, retention and correction approval.
packet.impact: Defines what receipts and country behavior may claim; zero-tax synthetic tests do not establish statutory compliance.
packet.acceptance: Qualified reviewer and independent checker bind dated sources and supported/unsupported rules to the country-pack version and release candidate.
packet.rollback: Keep unapproved statutory issuance disabled; preserve immutable evidence and route existing submission exceptions to their owner.

decisions.title: Pilot service levels and error budgets

packet.rationale: Retain the decision not to claim a production SLO until D-05 and measured workload baselines exist.
packet.alternatives: Measure and approve targets for a bounded workstation/cohort, or retain development-only service expectations.
packet.impact: Support staffing, timeout/retry budgets and expansion decisions must match observed capacity and failure recovery.
packet.acceptance: Record workload, concurrency, duration, latency percentiles, errors, recovery time, alert acknowledgement and explicitly approved thresholds.
packet.rollback: Stop expansion when the approved budget is exceeded; retain observability and incident ownership during rollback.

packet.rationale: Review the selected delivery-based recognition target with the controller and qualified accounting reviewer; ordinary immediate POS tests do not prove a complete delivery/invoice aggregate.
packet.alternatives: Keep delivery invoicing excluded, or approve a separately specified advance/deposit policy with its own recognition controls.
packet.impact: Prevents duplicate billing and premature revenue/receivable recognition across confirmation, delivery and invoicing.
packet.acceptance: Confirmation remains non-posting; eligible accepted delivery quantities, partial invoices and retries cannot create duplicate invoices, revenue or tax.
packet.rollback: Disable new unsupported delivery invoice creation; preserve posted documents and use approved linked corrections.

packet.rationale: Retain availability-only reservations and stock/COGS ownership at physical issue as the proposed policy; define negative-stock, UOM, lot and serial exclusions explicitly. The frozen evidence pointer postStockReservation names an unimplemented target, not a function verified in current source.
packet.alternatives: Limit release to immediate POS goods issue, or implement and approve reservation/fulfillment aggregates and unsupported-combination handling.
packet.impact: Aligns cashier availability, warehouse responsibility and finance valuation without double stock or COGS effects.
packet.acceptance: Concurrent reservation, partial issue, backorder, cancellation and reversal prove no oversell or duplicate COGS; reservation alone leaves on-hand and COGS unchanged.
packet.rollback: Disable unsupported reservation/fulfillment combinations and preserve source-linked stock events and commitments.

decisions.title: Business-day, statement, reconciliation and accounting-close boundary

packet.rationale: Retain separation of session, drawer, business day, statement, reconciliation and accounting close; a working drawer page does not prove end-to-end business-day close.
packet.alternatives: Limit supported close scope explicitly, or implement missing aggregates and obtain controller/treasury approval for the full close cycle.
packet.impact: Cashier declarations, supervisor variances, settlement matching and accountant period controls remain independently attributable.
packet.acceptance: Prove blind declaration where required, no self-approved material variance, cash/provider/ledger/bank tie-out and late-correction invalidation.
packet.rollback: Stop close finalization on unresolved differences; retain evidence and reopen through a typed, audited correction procedure.
